jobTitle: Teaching Assistant for Embedded Systems (IST Year 3 Grading Support)
jobDescription: The Teaching Assistant will support the Embedded Systems course for third-year Information Systems Technology (IST) students, with primary responsibility for accurate and timely grading of assignments, quizzes, lab reports, and coding exercises. The TA will review student submissions against rubrics, provide constructive feedback, maintain detailed grading records, and attend weekly coordination meetings with the Module Organizer. Occasional light support may include clarifying assignment instructions to students via the learning management system (LMS) and assisting in preparing grading keys or sample solutions under faculty supervision. This is a term-based, part-time role requiring consistency, attention to detail, and adherence to academic integrity standards.
requirements: Candidate must be an IST major (preferably Year 4 or recent graduate) with demonstrated academic excellence (minimum GPA 3.5/4.0) in Embedded Systems or closely related courses (e.g., Microcontrollers, Real-Time Systems, C Programming, Digital Electronics). Prior TA experience—especially in embedded labs or grading technical coursework—is strongly preferred. Proficiency in C/C++, basic familiarity with microcontroller platforms (e.g., ARM Cortex-M, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi Pico), and experience using version control (Git) and LMS tools (e.g., Moodle or Canvas) are required. Excellent written communication skills in English, strong time management, and the ability to interpret and apply grading rubrics objectively are essential.
